baby-newborn:
From newborn days until your baby is sitting unaided, my photo shoots follow your little one’s pace. I use wraps, outfits and props for a mix of styles, with plenty of time for settling, feeding and cuddles.

Safety and comfort come first. I’ve completed extensive training in wrapping and posing, including hands-on training, and take a gentle, patient approach to every baby.
maternity:
A little time to celebrate your pregnancy, with your comfort and preferences at the heart of the photo shoot. Partners and family are welcome at no extra cost, and you can choose from my outfits, fabrics and backdrops.

I recommend a session in your seventh or eighth month, with booking during your second trimester.
portraits: A versatile studio or location photo shoot for up to two people, or two plus a baby — from birthdays to simply spending time together. I combine a few posed portraits with natural moments, using two backdrop designs and props chosen around you.
family-portraits:
Bring your favourite people together for a mix of posed portraits and relaxed, playful photographs, in the studio or on location. Individual portraits and two backdrop setups are included.

For everyone’s comfort, my studio accommodates up to four adults plus little ones. Larger families can be photographed at the local community centre.
on-location:
Your home, a favourite place or a seasonal beauty spot — I can help you choose a setting for most of my packages. Editing is included, so the weather doesn’t need to be perfect. Location shoots aren’t suitable for baby or cake smash packages.

There’s no extra travel charge within 15 minutes. Further North East travel starts at £10, depending on distance, in addition to your package; send me your location for a quote.
cake-smash-bath:
A birthday, a little mess and lots of personality. Recommended up to age four, with a backdrop styled around your ideas and an 8-inch cake in your chosen colour; the remaining cake is yours to take home. A 6-inch cake reduces the price by £10.

Add a milk bath splash for the clean-up, or ask me about older birthdays. Please mention food allergies when enquiring. Floating balloons carry a surcharge, with alternatives available.
sitter:
For little ones who can sit or stand with help but aren’t yet walking, a Sitter photo shoot celebrates their growing personality. Two themes are included, with props and outfits to choose from — or bring your own favourites.

Choose my Durham studio or a nearby outdoor setting, weather permitting.
